description: This Go source file implements the FetchArtifactsAction in the Android Cuttlefish frontend's host orchestrator component. It manages fetching artifacts for Android builds, including initiating download operations, validating requests, and handling different artifact bundle types.

classes.name: FetchArtifactsActionOpts
classes.description: Defines the options for creating a FetchArtifactsAction, including request data, paths, operation manager, build API, bundle fetchers, artifact fetcher, and UUID generator.

classes.name: FetchArtifactsAction
classes.description: Encapsulates the logic for fetching artifacts, including running the fetch process, handling different bundle types, and managing the download operation.

methods.name: NewFetchArtifactsAction
methods.description: Constructor function to create and initialize a new FetchArtifactsAction instance with provided options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the fetch artifacts process, including validation, directory creation, starting the download asynchronously, and returning the operation.

methods.name: startDownload
methods.description: Performs the download process for artifacts based on the request, handling different bundle types and error conditions.

methods.name: validateFetchArtifactsRequest
methods.description: Validates the fetch artifacts request to ensure necessary fields are present.

methods.name: cloneRequest
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the fetch artifacts request using JSON marshaling and unmarshaling.
